shape: a small everyday annoyance someone causes now, seen from the day it stops

slides.text: i stopped counting coffee drops, [[the mug stayed upright]], and breathed

caption:
i notice how steady things feel when i stop the little counts
the quiet steadiness fills the room
send this to your best friend who always leaves their coffee mug on the edge

#selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself
